evidence: Replay of registered, completed LIBERO-10 episodes
method_expansion: Geometric Replanning with Adaptive Chunk Execution
paper_title: Between Glances: Geometric Memory for Adaptive Action Chunking
selection_rule: Selected qualitative examples at seed 7, matched by task and initial state. GRACE completes each selected task; at least one comparator fails or finishes in more execution steps. The main showcase covers ten tasks, with ten additional initializations in the supplemental collection. Aggregate performance is reported separately in the paper.
completion_measure: Recorded execution steps to first success, with one frame per step at 24 fps. Completion comparisons describe task execution progress; policy inference time is excluded.
